title: Cost explorer
description: See where spend goes over time, what it is on track to reach this month, and which budgets are at risk. Figures use your own prices.

forecast.title: Month end forecast
forecast.hint: Projected from recent full days. The range widens when daily spend is uneven.
forecast.chart: Cumulative spend this month with the projected range

movers.title: Top movers
movers.description: The largest increases against the previous period.
movers.none: Nothing grew against the previous period.

empty.noData: No cost data for this period yet.
empty.noTelemetryDescription: Cost is derived from measured usage. It appears once metrics are being collected.
empty.notConfiguredDescription: Costs are zero until you tell Levelrail what your servers or units cost.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.description: Monthly limits for a project, a tag or an app. Each one alerts once per threshold and can pause or throttle the apps in scope at 100%.
budgets.empty: No budgets yet. Add one below to get alerted before spend runs away.
budgets.name: Name
budgets.actionHint: Throttle and pause are lifted when you raise the budget or the month rolls over. Nothing is ever deleted.
budgets.deleteDescription: Any pause or throttle it applied is lifted. Spend history is not affected.
budgets.alertHint: Alerts go through your budget threshold alert rule. Add one under Alerts if you want email, Slack or webhook notices.

fix.label: Fix this budget
fix.pauseDescription: The app stops serving until you start it again. Its data is kept.
